description: This campaign is powered by people - not special interests. Every dollar you give helps us reach voters, share our message, and build a movement rooted in integrity and accountability. I am committed to 100% transparency. You deserve to know how much we raise, where it comes from, and how every dollar is spent. My goal is simple: build this campaign through small-dollar donations from people who believe in the policies we are fighting for - not just in the candidate.

title: Donate - Andrew Cottingham for Illinois State Representative
